findings.problem: In Spain, the adverb igual mostly means 'maybe' ('igual voy' = 'maybe I'll go'), and Spain says de todas formas or de todos modos for 'anyway', so spain should not be null.

back.es: igual (adverb, Latin American colloquial): anyway, all the same, regardless
back.example: They didn't invite me, but I'm going anyway.

note: The hint's "one word" is what rules out de todos modos, de todas formas and aun así, so it needs to stay.
